verdict.rationale: Elastic publishes a first-party MCP server repository (elastic/mcp-server-elasticsearch), and a probe confirms it is documented, so agents can reach Elasticsearch indexes through an official tool surface. The evidence only establishes that the server exists; it does not show which query, analytics, or index operations it exposes. missing for 10: documentation of the specific tools exposed (query/search, aggregations/analytics, index management operations), setup and auth details, any independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, agents can use my search indexes as a tool — an MCP server or tool-calling surface exposes query, analytics, and index operations
